payload.prompt: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Buchhaltungsdimension "Produktlinje" mit den Werten "Basis" und "Standard". Buchen Sie dann einen Beleg auf Konto 6540 über 25900 NOK, verknüpft mit dem Dimensionswert "Basis".

payload.goal: Create a custom accounting dimension 'Produktlinje' with values 'Basis' and 'Standard', then post a voucher to account 6540 for 25900 NOK linked to dimension value 'Basis'.
success_checks: Custom dimension 'Produktlinje' is created and visible in accounting settings
Voucher is posted to account 6540 with amount 25900 NOK
Voucher line is linked to dimension value 'Basis' of dimension 'Produktlinje'
Voucher is balanced (debit equals credit) and accepted by the system
risk_notes: No counter-account specified for the voucher — a balancing account (e.g. bank or accounts payable) must be determined before posting
VAT treatment for account 6540 (cost account) is not specified; vat_rate_percent left null — verify whether VAT applies
Posting date not provided; system date will be used unless specified
Custom dimensions may require a specific module to be enabled in Tripletex (e.g. 'Dimensjoner' module)
Account 6540 must exist in the chart of accounts; verify before posting
Sandbox is empty — no accounts, dimensions, or voucher types pre-exist; full setup chain required
payload.suggested_first_action: Enable the custom dimensions module in Tripletex via PUT /module if not already active, then POST to /dimension to create 'Produktlinje'.

line_items.description: Voucher posting to account 6540 linked to dimension value 'Basis'

ordered_steps: 1. Enable custom dimensions module: PUT /module {name: 'dimension'} if not active
2. Create custom dimension: POST /dimension {name: 'Produktlinje', isActive: true}
3. Create dimension value 'Basis': POST /dimensionValue {dimension: {id: <dimensionId>}, value: 'Basis', isActive: true}
4. Create dimension value 'Standard': POST /dimensionValue {dimension: {id: <dimensionId>}, value: 'Standard', isActive: true}
5. Verify account 6540 exists: GET /ledger/account?number=6540; create if missing via POST /ledger/account
6. Determine balancing account (e.g. 1920 bank or 2400 accounts payable) for the counter-entry
7. Post voucher: POST /ledger/voucher with two lines — debit 6540 for 25900 NOK with dimensionValue 'Basis', credit balancing account for 25900 NOK
8. Verify voucher is posted and balanced: GET /ledger/voucher/{id}
9. Confirm dimension value 'Basis' is correctly linked to the voucher line in the ledger

planned_endpoints.summary: Find salary type corresponding with sent data.
Find employees corresponding with sent data.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions

rules: For update tasks, GET /employee with fields=* first so you have id and version.
PUT /employee/{id} MUST include id and version from the GET response.
Only send the fields the prompt explicitly asks to change.
If the prompt asks for admin/access privileges, use grant_employee_entitlements instead of guessing employee fields.
Requires startDate, municipalityDate, municipality, name, and organizationNumber.
Get municipality first: GET /municipality/query?query=Oslo&from=0&count=1.
Example body: {name: 'Hovedavdeling', organizationNumber: '999999999', startDate: '2026-01-01', municipalityDate: '2026-01-01', municipality: {id: mun_id}}
Employee MUST have dateOfBirth set. If missing, PUT /employee/{id} with dateOfBirth first.
Requires division: {id: division_id}. Create division first if GET /division returns empty.
Set startDate to '2026-01-01' or earlier than the salary period.
Set isMainEmployer=true and taxDeductionCode='loennFraHovedarbeidsgiver'.
ALWAYS use params={"nameAndCode": "XXXX"} to filter by STYRK code. NEVER paginate through all codes.
Example: GET /employee/employment/occupationCode with params={"nameAndCode": "3512"} to find STYRK 3512.
If no results, try broader search: params={"nameAndCode": "351"}.
Use 'annualSalary' NOT 'salary' for the salary field.
Use 'percentageOfFullTimeEquivalent' for stillingsprosent (e.g., 80.0 for 80%).
For employment type: use 'employmentType' with values like 'ORDINARY' (fast stilling), not 'FIXED_SALARY'.
For shift work: use 'shiftWork' with values like 'NONE', not 'NOT_SHIFT_WORK'.
Each specification MUST have both 'rate' and 'count' fields. Do NOT use 'amount'.
Example specification: {salaryType: {id: fastlonn_id}, rate: 59600, count: 1}
Resolve salaryType IDs by NAME from GET /salary/type (e.g., 'Fastlønn', 'Timelønn', 'Overtid', 'Bonus', 'Feriepenger') — NEVER by list position/index.
Match salary type names case-insensitively and by exact semantic meaning (base salary uses Fastlønn, hourly uses Timelønn, etc.).
Employee MUST have an active employment record covering the salary period.
If you get 'ikke registrert med et arbeidsforhold': create employment first via POST /employee/employment.
Employment requires a division. Create one with POST /division if none exists.
Employee MUST have dateOfBirth set before creating employment.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.

For supplier costs: use TWO postings — (1) DEBIT expense account with vatType=3 and amountGross=GROSS amount, (2) CREDIT account 2400 with vatType=0 and amountGross=NEGATIVE GROSS amount with supplier ref. Tripletex auto-splits the debit into net+VAT. A SINGLE debit posting with vatType=3 causes 422 on many accounts. ALWAYS include the credit to 2400. Ignore legalVatTypes — vatType=3 works for auto-split even when not listed.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For ANY posting on account 2400 (Leverandørgjeld), ALWAYS include supplier={"id": supplier_id}.
For ANY posting on account 1500 (Kundefordringer), ALWAYS include customer={"id": customer_id}.
Month-end depreciation: debit a 6000-series depreciation expense (e.g., 6010), credit accumulated depreciation (typically 1039/1049/1059) — do NOT credit 1209.
Month-end payroll accrual: derive amount from actual salary transactions/postings in period; NEVER invent a payroll amount.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

payload.text:
Let me analyze the task:

1. Create a custom accounting dimension "Produktlinje" with values "Basis" and "Standard"
2. Post a voucher to account 6540 for 25900 NOK linked to dimension value "Basis"

From the execution_brief:
- Account 6540 is pre-resolved: ID 503076098
- I need to use POST /ledger/accountingDimensionName to create the dimension
- POST /ledger/accountingDimensionValue to create values
- POST /ledger/voucher to post the voucher
- I need a counter-account (1920 bank) - need to resolve it


- Bank account setup isn't required for voucher posting, just the account ID. Since 6540 is already resolved, I'll need to fetch account 1920, then create the dimension and its values before posting the voucher.

Looking at the schema requirements, AccountingDimensionName needs dimensionName, description, active, and dimensionIndex (read-only), while AccountingDimensionValue requires displayName, dimensionIndex, active, number, showInVoucherRegistration, and position. For the 25900 NOK posting to cost account 6540, I'll use vatType=0 with matching debit and credit entries, linking the dimension value through freeAccountingDimension1 on the voucher posting. I should check with the API advisor on how to properly reference the dimension value in the posting.

From the trace example, freeAccountingDimension1 is the right field to use, and since dimensionIndex is read-only, it'll be assigned automatically. I need to sequence the calls carefully: first get account 1920 and create the AccountingDimensionName in parallel, then use the returned dimensionIndex to create the dimension values, and finally use the dimension value ID when building the voucher. I'll get the dimensionIndex from the AccountingDimensionName response, then kick off the parallel calls to create the accounts and dimension name before moving on to the dependent steps.

payload.headline: Dimension and values created correctly, but voucher posting failed scoring check.
what_went_wrong: Check 2 (voucher posting) failed despite API returning 200 OK — the voucher may not have been correctly linked to dimension value 'Basis' in a way the scorer verified.
The freeAccountingDimension1 field reference '$REF:ledger_1' may not have resolved correctly to the actual dimension value ID (21066) in the voucher posting body.
The vatType {id: 0} usage may be incorrect — account 6540 may require a specific VAT type ID rather than 0, potentially causing the posting to be rejected or misconfigured.

The counter-account lookup (GET /ledger/account) returned ID 503075828 but the agent used a placeholder '$REF:account_1920' — if this reference didn't resolve, the voucher structure could be malformed.
what_worked: Custom dimension 'Produktlinje' was created successfully (ID 3436) with both values 'Basis' (21066) and 'Standard' (21067) — Check 1 passed.
Efficient execution with only 6 API calls and 0 errors.
what_to_try_next: Verify that freeAccountingDimension1 in the voucher posting correctly references the dimension value ID (21066) as a resolved integer, not a placeholder string.
Check the correct vatType ID for account 6540 (cost account) — use GET /ledger/vatType to find the right no-VAT type ID instead of assuming id=0.
After posting the voucher, do a GET /ledger/voucher/{id} to confirm the dimension value is actually attached to the posting before finalizing.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account — account 6540 was pre-resolved; fetching 1920 could be done more directly with query params like ?number=1920 instead of a broad account list call.
